definitions.lord_2: Lord of the 2nd house from Lagna (Dhana / Kudumba / Vaak sthana).
definitions.core_principle: Wealth, assets or fame come most easily through the affairs of the house where lord_2 sits.
definitions.connection: lord_2 in house H, OR lord_H in house 2, OR conjunction, mutual aspect, sign exchange (parivartana) or nakshatra exchange between lord_2 and lord_H. Treat all as the same connection.
definitions.caveat: Results are modified by aspecting planets, conjoined planets, sign dispositor, nakshatra lord and the running dasa/bhukti. A promised yoga may not show until a supporting dasa arrives.
